title: cornus capitata var. angustata
intro: Cornus capitata var. angustata, commonly known as Japanese Cornel or Japanese Dogwood, is a variety of flowering plant native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever and reduce oxidative stress. Therapeutically, Cornus capitata var. angustata has been used to treat conditions such as dysentery, diarrhea, and fever, with its therapeutic actions including antipyretic and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cornus capitata var. angustata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
